muid.description: Parameter defines the MUID of the place you want to search. You can use the MUID from the Apple Maps Places API response. (e.g. `18366846785603624515` for London). You can also pass multiple MUIDs separated by commas (e.g., `18366846785603624515,11018610862491969006` to get London and Austin). Upto 50 MUIDs can be fetched in a single request.

locale.description: Parameter defines the locale the results should be localized for. Locales for Apple Maps are represented as `<LANGUAGE>-<REGION>`. (defaults to `en-US`, the locale for U.S. English). Head to Apple Maps Locales for the list of available locales.

# Apple Maps Place

Get an Apple Maps place by MUID with name, category, rating, address, phone, website, hours and coordinates.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/apple-maps/place" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"muid": "<muid from Apple Maps Search>"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

| `locale` | string | No | Parameter defines the locale the results should be localized for. Locales for Apple Maps are represented as `<LANGUAGE>-<REGION>`. (defaults to `en-US`, the locale for U.S. English). Head to Apple Maps Locales for the list of available loca |
| `json_restrictor` | string | No | Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |

$0.010 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
